member.name: T:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1
member.summary: A modern, high-quality hybrid Tree + ListView control for WinForms (.NET 9+). Supports hierarchical data, columns, lazy loading for large datasets, excellent in-place editing, clickable column sorting, multi-selection, checkboxes, filtering, type-ahead search, per-node icons, tree connector lines, hover highlighting, and light/dark themes.
member.typeparam: The type of the data model for each node. For best results with immutable records, prefer using after creating an updated instance (see remarks on SetCellValueSetter).

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.SetCellValueSetter(System.Action{`0,Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.TreeListColumn{`0},System.Object})
member.summary: Sets the action invoked when the user commits an in-place edit. The action is responsible for writing the value back to the model (or data source).

remarks.para: Records / immutable models: Because records are immutable, the setter cannot mutate the instance. Preferred pattern: create a new record (e.g. model with { Name = (string)newValue }), update your source collections so that future / children getters see consistent data, then call to swap the reference inside the control's tree nodes while preserving expand/selection state. See the demo for a complete example.
For mutable POCOs you can mutate directly and call or as needed.

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.SetFilter(System.Func{`0,System.Boolean})
member.summary: Applies a row filter. A node remains visible when it matches the predicate or any of its descendants do; ancestors of matches are automatically expanded so matches become visible.
member.remarks: Filtering needs to evaluate descendants, so children are loaded on demand for the whole tree. For very large virtual trees consider filtering at the data source instead.

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.ClearFilter
member.summary: Removes any active filter. The expansion state created by the filter is kept.

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.Rebuild
member.summary: Rebuilds the visible row list from the current expanded state. Call this after you have mutated the underlying data (add/remove children, reordered items, etc.) while the control's nodes are already loaded. Does not reload children from getters.

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.Reload
member.summary: Fully reloads the tree from the current root models using the registered children getter. All expanded state is lost; nodes will be re-expanded on demand when the user expands them again. Use when your root collection or children source has changed structurally.

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.ReplaceModel(`0,`0)
member.summary: Replaces a model instance in the tree with a different instance (primary use case: immutable records). The node keeps its parent, children, expanded state and position in the tree. Selection is preserved. After calling this you typically also want to update the same logical item inside your own source collections so that and future children enumeration remain consistent.
member.param: The model reference currently held by a tree node.
The new model instance that should take its place for display and future operations.

member.name: M:Galaxy.CommonControls.ModernTreeListView.ModernTreeListView`1.RefreshObject(`0)
member.summary: Invalidates and redraws the row for the specified model if it is currently visible. Useful after external changes to a mutable model's display properties when you do not want a full . For immutable records, prefer followed by this (or just ReplaceModel).

member.summary: Sorts the tree by the specified column using the given direction. Sorting is applied to the siblings of each level (per-parent), is stable, and respects the current expanded state.
